properties.OutageReportInfo: Newfoundland & Labrador Hydro wishes to advise its customers of an Emergency outage to Hawkes Bay and River of Ponds to safely make repairs at the Station. Outage time approximately 1 hour. Newfoundland and Labrador Hydro apologizes to its customers for any inconvenience this outage may cause. We appreciate your understanding as we work to maintain safe and reliable infrastructure. Thank you, NL Hydro
